title: Yellowed Sweet Hakka Redcurrants Dumplings
description: A funky and comforting Hakka dish featuring redcurrants and lamination-puff, perfect for a light snack. This raw-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Roll out the lamination puff to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a bowl, mix together the redcurrants, sugar, water, and cornstarch.
Add the vegetable oil, salt, and ginger to the bowl and mix well.
Spoon the redcurrant mixture onto one half of the lamination puff, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the lamination puff over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Use a knife to cut the dumplings into desired shapes.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve the dumplings warm and enjoy.
